description:
Cast Mirror Room by paying {2}{U}
When Mirror Room enters, it triggers, creating a token copy of Esper Terra that is a Reflection in addition to its other types. It'll enter with a lore counter on it.
Put the Esper Terra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Esper Terra token's first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
